tabs.content:
union 
    (WindTurbineTelemetry   | extend stream = "WindTurbineTelemetry"),
    (SolarInverterTelemetry | extend stream = "SolarInverterTelemetry"),
    (GridTelemetry          | extend stream = "GridTelemetry"),
    (VesselPositions        | extend stream = "VesselPositions"),
    (EmissionsStream        | extend stream = "EmissionsStream")
| where timestamp > ago(2m)
| summarize event_count = count(), latest = max(timestamp) by stream
| order by stream


WindTurbineTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(5m)
| where vibration_mm_s > 5
| summarize 
    spike_count = count(), 
    max_vib = max(vibration_mm_s), 
    avg_vib = avg(vibration_mm_s) 
    by turbine_id
| order by spike_count desc

WindFaults()
| where timestamp > ago(3m) and is_fault
| summarize 
    spike_count = count(),
    avg_vib = round(avg(vibration_mm_s), 2),
    max_vib = round(max(vibration_mm_s), 2),
    severity = max(fault_type)
  by turbine_id
| order by spike_count desc
